model.architecture: Hybrid GatedDeltaNet: 24 linear-attention + 8 gated full-attention layers; text decoder only (vision tower dropped)

variants.quantization: int8 dynamic on linears + embedding (convs and the delta rule stay float), fp32 activations declared

recommended.reason: Generation verified on Apple M4 Max (8/8 on CPU and GPU); GPU is the faster measured backend

iOS: not yet measured; no device backend recommendation is claimed

Galaxy S26 CPU: generation degrades with this file (run-on answers in 2 of 8 gate questions, no final answer in the thinking-on probe) while the same file passes every Mac gate; cause not established
